name: Caro Prorofort
source: Caro is the leader of the group of girls involved in the conflict, the scale of which they are not even aware. As a good leader, Caro tries to rally his team and protect these strong, but at the same time, fragile girls. His brave and pure heart, a sturdy sword, and dreams of a bright future, will certainly help them to overcome all the hardships and bring peace to the earth.
